## About this demo

This small report section demonstrates the sidebar navigation, page layout,
and shared NBIS branding of the `folium` multi-page template.

## What the skill configures

- project metadata;
- the GitHub Pages workflow;
- required Quarto extensions;
- reproducible R and Python dependency handling when code is enabled.

The source fixture is pinned in this repository so this demo can be rendered
reproducibly, independent of upstream template changes.
